subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Atlas evaluation timeline & owners
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@atlashealth.com>, Jill Morgan <jill.morgan@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Atlas evaluation timeline & owners

Thanks again for your time this morning — quick recap from our MAP checkpoint and clear owners so we stay on the same cadence. Highlights below and an updated MAP spreadsheet attached (Atlas_MAP_v2.xlsx).

Key decisions
- Redwood to provide a 3-day perf test window (staging) and a sample production-like dataset for validation.
- Sales and procurement milestones split: SOW -> Procurement -> Test -> Pilot.

Action items (owners & due dates)
1) Redwood: Deliver staging endpoint + credentials — Owner: Aditya Rao — Due: 2026-04-23
2) Atlas: Share redacted sample dataset + retention requirements — Owner: Sam Patel — Due: 2026-04-22
3) Atlas procurement: Confirm PO process & mandate contact — Owner: procurement@atlashealth.com — Due: 2026-04-27
4) Redwood: Provide draft SOW for pilot pricing — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2026-04-21 (attached Draft_SOW_Atlas.pdf)

Quick asks for this week
- Sam/Jill: confirm dataset delivery timeline (best-guess is fine).
- Procurement: flag any required security artifacts (SOC2 report, data handling).

Next week's agenda (tentative)
- Kick off perf test window review (metrics + acceptance)
- Procurement touchpoint (PO timing)
- Contract redlines Q/A

Thanks — I'll consolidate updates mid-week and send a short status note.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Atlas evaluation timeline & owners

Thanks Neha — appreciate the clear breakdown. Quick clarifications:
- We should be able to share a redacted sample by EOD 2026-04-22; Sam will own this.
- Procurement: I'll introduce our procurement lead on Thursday; they typically need a draft SOW + standard security pack (SOC2 + data retention statement).

One ask from the tech side: can Redwood confirm whether the perf test will accept a 1M token/day simulation, or do you prefer a shorter burst profile? That affects how we prepare the dataset.

On the SOW — Marissa, can you confirm whether the pilot pricing in the attached draft includes ingress/egress assumptions?

Sam

Sr. Engineering Manager, Atlas Health
sam.patel@atlashealth.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-04-21T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Atlas evaluation timeline & owners

Sam/Jill — short technical note:
- Staging endpoint will support both burst and sustained profiles. For the perf window we recommend a 3-day run with a 24-hour sustained profile at ~600k tokens/day and two 4-hour peak bursts at ~1.2M tokens to simulate daily peaks.
- I will upload the credentials and a short runbook to the shared Redwood folder once Sam confirms dataset format (CSV/ndjson).

Planned deliverables & owners (technical)
- Staging endpoint + runbook — Aditya Rao — Due 2026-04-23
- KV cache tuning doc — Aditya Rao — Due 2026-04-26

On dataset format: CSV with columns (event_time, user_id_hash, prompt_text, expected_label) is ideal. If you need a template I can send one by EOD.

- Aditya

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Sam Patel <sam.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Atlas evaluation timeline & owners

Looping in Karthik for pricing follow-ups — Karthik, see the draft SOW attached. A few notes:
- Draft includes pilot pricing for 3-week scoped run + 30-day logs retention. If Atlas needs longer retention or dedicated capacity we should surface that as a separate line item.
- Procurement typically asks for a PO + signature (DocuSign link to follow).

Action for procurement (external): Neha, please ask procurement@atlashealth.com to confirm any invoice/legal routing details so we can align the SOW contact block.

I'll also add a short pricing appendix to the SOW and circulate an updated PDF by tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-04-24T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint — consolidated status, owner confirmations, and next agenda

Team — quick consolidated status ahead of next week's check. Thanks for the quick turnarounds.

Status snapshot
- Dataset: Sam confirmed internal delivery ETA 2026-04-22 (received). Thank you — we have the initial redacted file and Aditya is validating format.
- Staging endpoint: Aditya to deliver credentials by 2026-04-23 (in progress; expected tomorrow).
- SOW: Marissa to send pricing appendix update (Marissa noted she'll circulate the PDF on 2026-04-23).
- Procurement: procurement@atlashealth.com to confirm PO routing; no blocker reported yet.

Updated action items (finalized)
A) Aditya Rao — Provide staging endpoint + credentials + runbook — Due: 2026-04-23 — Attachment: Atlas_MAP_v2.xlsx (maps test windows)
B) Marissa Cole — Publish SOW appendix + updated PDF — Due: 2026-04-23 — Attachment: Draft_SOW_Atlas.pdf
C) Procurement@atlashealth.com — Confirm PO contact & any invoice terms — Due: 2026-04-27
D) Sam Patel — Share final dataset & retention note (received) — Completed 2026-04-22

Decisions made
- Acceptance criteria for pilot: 95th percentile latency under 450ms for the agreed sustained profile; accuracy regression vs. baseline must be <2%.
- Billing: pilot will be billed per token for the pilot window; any dedicated capacity will be quoted after pilot.

Next-week agenda (2026-04-28 weekly checkpoint)
1) Perf test results walkthrough (Aditya)
2) Procurement status & PO timing (procurement representative)
3) Contract finalization timeline and DocuSign prep (Marissa)
4) Any security artifact gaps (SOC2 copies, encryption details)

If there are objections to any of the owners/due dates, flag by EOD tomorrow; otherwise I'll close the MAP spreadsheet and push the HubSpot stage to "Pilot: In Progress". HubSpot link below.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/contacts/ATL-4721
